page: Microsoft Azure F64as_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the Fasv6 family. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor running at 3.7 GHz, featuring 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs with a 1.0 thread-per-core allocation. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable and operates under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier multi-core performance, with stress-ng multi-core scoring 196,900.41 and PassMark CPU scoring 91,536.52, both placing in the top 10% of tested servers. Single-core performance is strong, with a Geekbench single-core score of 2,099.0 and a stress-ng single-core score of 3,080.88, placing in the top 25%. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, reaching a top-tier 9,339.97 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and a strong 289.01 GB/sec for large-block reads.

This server demonstrates strong capabilities in database operations, scoring 29,419.76 on PassMark database benchmarks, and achieves top-tier Redis SET throughput at 132.21 million operations per second. It is also highly capable in software compilation, ray tracing, and multi-threaded decompression. For language model tasks, it processes 7B model prompts at a strong 231.52 tokens per second and generates text at a top-tier 48.78 tokens per second. Given the high compute density and lack of local storage, this configuration offers a cost-efficient profile for compute-heavy workloads, multi-threaded applications, and database operations that leverage external Premium Storage.
